title: Statistical Inference for Series Systems from Masked Failure Time Data: The Exponential Case
description: We consider the problem of estimating component failure rates in series systems when observations consist of system failure times paired with partial information about the failed component. For the case where component lifetimes follow exponential distributions, we derive closed-form expressions for the maximum likelihood estimator, the Fisher information matrix, and establish sufficient statistics. The asymptotic sampling distribution of the estimator is characterized and confidence intervals are provided.
